title: Hide XP Bar
description: Uh Oh, Where'd the XP Bar go? This mod hides the XP Bar.
body: Hides the vanilla XP bar from your HUD for a cleaner screen or more immersion. Lightweight, client-side, no toggle(yet?) Perfect for screenshots, cinematics, or minimalist setups. No performance impact and should work seamlessly with other HUD mods. Can confirm AppleSkin works.
